title: Mega Radio – Live Global Radio
summary: Listen to 60000+ local fm radio stations with an internet radio streaming player
description:
LISTEN TO LIVE WORLDWIDE ONLINE RADIOS

 Listen to global radios anywhere in the world with Megaradio! 📻🌎 Have a personal online radio box that will take you to live local radio stations in 100+ countries across the globe. Listening to local fm radio on your phone has never been this easy as with this online fm am radio tuner free app!

SEARCH RADIO STATIONS AND LISTEN IN THE BACKGROUND

 🔎 Know what live radio station you want to listen to? Use our search bar and find the online fm radio station fast. Looking for web radio channel ideas? Browse our preselected categories as well as internet radios favored by other users of our online radio app. 🎵 FIND RADIOS BY GENRE Find radio live streaming stations that play your favorite music genre by browsing the radios by music genres such as rock, electronic, jazz, hip-hop, pop, classical, and more! See the number of stations for each category. ▶️ NOT JUST MUSIC RADIOS Listen to local news, sports commentary, radio talk shows, and podcasts on different themes by exploring other radio station categories. Our online radio app and in-built online radio tuner have tens of thousands of amazing international radios. 👍 ADD RADIOS TO FAVORITES Find your favorite radios using our radio FM streaming app. Whether you know your favorites, or you want to save a newly discovered live radio station, you can do it all with our radio live streaming app. 📻 MEGA RADIO LIVE FEATURES: - listen to online radio live - listen to radios in the background - simple radio streaming UI - 10000+ local radio stations in 100+ countries around the world (USA radios, Europe radios, Asia radios and more!) - find radio stations by keyword - find radio stations by music genre: Electronic, Pop, Rock, Oldies, Jazz, 80s, Dance, Top 40, and more - find radio stations by category: Christian, talk radio, public, news stations, and more - favorite internet radio stations for quick access - check the radio favorites of other Megaradio users to find new radio stations that suit your interests - request a station to be added to our internet radio player. Now it’s time to see why we are one of the best free radio apps for android. Improve your world radio listening experience by having a 24/7 online radio tuner in your pocket! 🎧 Download our internet radio broadcasting app and listen to free online radio stations WORLDWIDE.
